_comment: Canonical docs-site matrix of locales x versions. The deploy job owns ONE copy of this file and feeds it to every branch build (DOCS_VERSIONS_FILE), so the switchers never drift between the 1.x and 2.x branches. build.php falls back to the values baked here when no env override is set. `branch` is the ref each version is built from — always a long-lived branch (1.x, 2.x), never a release branch that is deleted after merging: a missing branch fails the deploy.
